hooks.name: KiroGraph Deferred Sync
hooks.description: Sync the KiroGraph index when the agent stops and a dirty marker is present. Hardening notes: (1) runs from the repo root — hook cwd is not guaranteed, a bare `kirograph` in the wrong cwd answers 'not initialized'; (2) skips if another sync is already running — two overlapping syncs fight over kirograph.db.lock and a killed one leaves the lock behind, which silently broke the index for a week (every MCP call answered 'KiroGraph not initialized'); (3) clears a stale lock via `kirograph unlock`, which (since v1.x) releases it only when the owning PID is dead — this replaces the old `find -mmin +30 -empty` heuristic that missed locks held by a zombie/detached sync (non-empty, recent) and let 'database is locked' pile up; (4) logs to .kirograph/hook.log instead of discarding stderr; (5) runs at low CPU priority — a sync costs ~3-4 min even with nothing to sync (full scan + global resolve of ~47k symbols) and ~20 min after ~130 changed files.
